license_required.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person or entity to practice or to offer to practice engineering and/or surveying in this state, as defined in the provisions of this act, or to use in connection with any name or otherwise assume or advertise any title or description tending to convey the impression that they are a licensed engineer, professional engineer, professional structural engineer, a licensed surveyor and/or professional surveyor, unless such person has been duly licensed, authorized, or is exempt under the provisions of this act.

issuing_authority.value: State Board of Licensure for Professional Engineers and Surveyors
issuing_authority.quote: The practice of engineering or surveying shall be deemed a privilege granted by the state through the State Board of Licensure for Professional Engineers and Surveyors

name.value: State Board of Licensure for Professional Engineers and Surveyors
name.quote: The State Board of Licensure for Professional Engineers and Surveyors is hereby re-created

type.quote: The Board shall consist of four professional engineers and two professional surveyors

degree_required.value: EAC/ABET-accredited bachelor's program in engineering, or equivalent; or related science bachelor's; or EAC/ABET or ETAC/ABET master's; or non-accredited bachelor's, master's, or doctorate; or EAC/M-ABET master's; or earned doctoral degree in engineering
degree_required.quote: a degree in engineering from an EAC/ABET-accredited bachelor's program, or the equivalent

accrediting_body.quote: a degree in engineering from an EAC/ABET-accredited bachelor's program, or the equivalent

degree_level.quote: a degree in engineering from an EAC/ABET-accredited bachelor's program, or the equivalent

school_approval_basis.quote: a degree in engineering from an EAC/ABET-accredited bachelor's program, or the equivalent

credential_pegged.quote: An individual seeking licensure as a professional engineer shall possess one or more of the following education qualifications

required.quote: an individual who qualifies pursuant to subparagraph a of paragraph 1 of this subsection: four (4) years of experience after the bachelor's degree is conferred

experience_source.quote: An individual seeking licensure as a professional engineer shall present evidence of a specific record of engineering experience following the conferment of the qualifying degree

duration.value: 2–6 years depending on degree level (4 years for EAC/ABET bachelor's; 6 years for related science bachelor's; 3 years for master's; 2 years for doctorate)
duration.quote: an individual who qualifies pursuant to subparagraph a of paragraph 1 of this subsection: four (4) years of experience after the bachelor's degree is conferred

kind.value: progressive engineering experience in responsible charge
kind.quote: This experience should be progressive and of a grade and character that indicate to the Board that the applicant may be competent to practice engineering.

exams.name: NCEES Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) examination
exams.notes: May be waived for applicants with at least 15 years of progressive engineering experience
exams.quote: Pass the applicable examinations set forth in this section... NCEES Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) examination

exams.quote: NCEES Principles and Practice of Engineering (PE) examination

exams.name: Oklahoma Law and Engineering (OLE) examination
exams.notes: Board examination; re-examination as directed by the Board

interval_years.quote: The Board shall issue licenses and certificates of authority for firms for a term of twenty-four (24) months.

required.quote: Every licensee is required to comply with the Board's rules regarding continuing education or meet the Model NCEES Continuing Professional Competency standard requirement, which is equivalent to fifteen (15) professional development hours per calendar year with no allowable carryover, as a condition of license renewal.

hours_per_period.quote: fifteen (15) professional development hours per calendar year with no allowable carryover

period_years.quote: fifteen (15) professional development hours per calendar year with no allowable carryover

available.quote: An individual holding a license to engage in the practice of engineering issued by a proper authority of any state, jurisdiction, or foreign country, based on requirements that do not conflict with the provisions of this act, and possessing credentials that are, in the judgment of the Board, of a standard not lower than that specified in the applicable licensure act in effect in Oklahoma at the time such license was issued may, upon application, be licensed without further examination except as required to examine the applicant's knowledge of statutes, rules, and other requirements unique to this state.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a license from another state/jurisdiction/foreign country meeting equivalent or higher standards; or hold an active NCEES Record. May be licensed without further examination except for Oklahoma law/statutes. Lower-standard licenses may still be considered per Board rules.
requirements.quote: An individual holding an active NCEES Record whose qualifications, as evidenced by the NCEES Record, meet the requirements of this act may, upon application, be licensed without further examination except as required to examine the applicant's knowledge of statutes, rules, and other requirements unique to Oklahoma.

exists.quote: The State Board of Licensure for Professional Engineers and Surveyors is hereby re-created

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any fraud or deceit in obtaining or attempting to obtain or renew a license, certificate, or in taking exams
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any fraud or deceit in obtaining or attempting to obtain or renew a license, or a certificate of authority, or in taking the examinations administered by the Board or its authorized representatives

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, misrepresentation, gross negligence, gross incompetence, misconduct, or dishonest practice in engineering or surveying
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any fraud, misrepresentation, gross negligence, gross incompetence, misconduct or dishonest practice, in the practice of engineering or surveying

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of or plea to a felony substantially relating to engineering/surveying or involving dishonesty
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of or entry of a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to a felony crime that substantially relates to the practice of engineering or surveying and poses a reasonable threat to public safety

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with any provisions of the act or its rules and regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with any of the provisions of this act or any of the rules or regulations pertaining thereto

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary action or voluntary surrender of license in another jurisdiction to avoid discipline
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Disciplinary action, including voluntary surrender of a professional engineer's or professional surveyor's license in order to avoid disciplinary action by another state, territory, the District of Columbia, a foreign country, the United States government, or any other governmental agency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure within 30 days to provide information requested by the Board during investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure, within thirty (30) days, to provide information requested by the Board or its designated staff as a result of a formal or informal investigation or complaint to the Board which would indicate a violation of this act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly making or signing false statements, certificates, or affidavits
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly making false statements or signing false statements, certificates or affidavits

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or assisting another person or entity in violating the act or its rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or assisting another person or entity in violating any provision of this act or the rules or regulations pertaining thereto

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using a seal or practicing while license is restricted, suspended, revoked, nonrenewed, retired, or inactive
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any terms imposed by the Board, or using a seal or practicing professional engineering or professional surveying while the professional engineer's license or professional surveyor's license is restricted, suspended, revoked, nonrenewed, retired or inactive

disciplinary_grounds.description: Signing or affixing seal to documents not prepared by or under the direct control of the licensee in responsible charge
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Signing, affixing the professional engineer's or professional surveyor's seal, or permitting the professional engineer's or professional surveyor's seal or signature to be affixed to any specifications, reports, drawings, plans, design information, construction documents, calculations, other documents, or revisions thereof, which have not been prepared by, or under the direct control and personal supervision of the professional engineer or professional surveyor in responsible charge

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct likely to deceive, defraud, harm, or endanger the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in dishonorable, unethical or unprofessional conduct of a character likely to deceive, defraud, harm or endanger the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing false testimony or information to the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Providing false testimony or information to the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual intoxication or addiction to alcohol or illegal controlled dangerous substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual intoxication or addiction to the use of alcohol or to the illegal use of a controlled dangerous substance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing engineering or surveying services outside the licensee's areas of competence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing engineering or surveying services outside any of the licensee's areas of competence or an engineer's areas of competence designated in the official Board records

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating the Oklahoma Minimum Standards for the Practice of Surveying
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating the Oklahoma Minimum Standards for the Practice of Surveying

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to obtain the required professional development hours as approved by the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to obtain the required professional development hours, as approved by the Board, Board staff or Continuing Education Committee as required by an audit.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: The practice of or offer to practice engineering or surveying by firms authorized under this act, or by more than one person acting individually through a firm, is permitted provided... The firm has been issued a certificate of authority by the Board.

definition_quote.value: "Practice of engineering" means any service or creative work requiring engineering education, training and experience in the application of engineering principles and the interpretation of engineering data to engineering activities, including the engineering design of buildings, structures, products, machines, processes, and systems, that potentially impact the life, health, property and welfare of the public.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of engineering" means any service or creative work requiring engineering education, training and experience in the application of engineering principles and the interpretation of engineering data to engineering activities, including the engineering design of buildings, structures, products, machines, processes, and systems, that potentially impact the life, health, property and welfare of the public.

methods_authorized.quote: The services may include, but are not limited to, providing planning, studies, designs, design coordination, drawings, specifications, and other technical submissions; engineering reports or material developed in connection with expert witness testimony or anticipated testimony; commissioning of engineered systems; and performing surveying that is incidental to the practice of engineering

covers_land_surveying.quote: The State Board of Licensure for Professional Engineers and Surveyors is hereby re-created

surveyor_in_training_certificate_availab.quote: The Board shall issue to any applicant who, in the opinion of the Board, has met the requirements of this act, a certificate as an engineer intern or surveyor intern which indicates that his or her name has been recorded as such in the Board office.

postgraduate_degree_experience_credit_ye.quote: a graduate degree that is used to satisfy education requirements cannot be applied for experience credit toward licensure. To be eligible for experience credit, graduate degrees shall be relevant to the applicant's area of professional practice.

responsible_charge_defined.quote: "Responsible charge" means direct control and personal supervision of engineering or surveying work

seal_required_on_documents.quote: Documents must be sealed and signed in accordance with the Board rules whenever presented to a client, a user or any public or governmental agency.

seal_document_types.quote: Signing, affixing the professional engineer's or professional surveyor's seal, or permitting the professional engineer's or professional surveyor's seal or signature to be affixed to any specifications, reports, drawings, plans, design information, construction documents, calculations, other documents, or revisions thereof

firm_practice_allowed.quote: The practice of or offer to practice engineering or surveying by firms authorized under this act, or by more than one person acting individually through a firm, is permitted provided

value: Practice of any other legally recognized profession
Temporary practice by nonresident engineers licensed in another state who have applied for Oklahoma licensure

exemptions_from_licensure.quote: This act shall not be construed to prevent: 1. Other professions. The practice of any other legally recognized profession; 2. Temporary license... 3. Employees and subordinates... 4. Material takeoff...

code_of_ethics_in_statute.quote: The Board shall prepare and adopt Rules of Professional Conduct for Professional Engineers and Surveyors

value: no more than two professional engineer board members shall have the same primary area of competence; at least one Professional Structural Engineer required

board_member_responsible_charge_years_re.quote: The member shall have been in responsible charge of engineering projects for at least five (5) years and shall be a licensed professional engineer in this state.

Contractors executing work designed by a licensed engineer (construction execution only)
Building trades workers, craft workers, and construction superintendents/supervisors/inspectors performing customary duties

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: The work of an employee or a subordinate of a person holding a license under this act... is allowed; provided, such work does not include final engineering or surveying designs or decisions and is done under the direct supervision of and verified by a person holding a license under this act

Land surveyor interns
Teaching engineering, architectural, landscape architectural, or surveying courses at accredited institutions

Nonresident persons, firms, or corporations meeting specified out-of-state criteria
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: The practice or offer to practice engineering by a person not a resident of or having no established place of business in this state is allowed; provided, such person is legally qualified by licensure to practice engineering

Agricultural work not required to be of public record
Revegetation, restoration, reclamation, rehabilitation, or erosion control for disturbed land not affecting public health, safety, or welfare
